title: Twist · Unwind screen: stop looking like Home

t.text: Twist · Unwind screen: stop looking like Home

n0.text: Now: same skeleton (dial, big number, button at the bottom)

annotations.text: A · The whole screen is the button. Hold anywhere and orange rises from the bottom; full screen = unlocked. Huge countdown top-left. Let go and it drains back down.
B · Text first: how much time was left and what comes back. A wide bar at the bottom fills while you hold. Adds friction through meaning rather than the dial.
C · Not a screen but a paper sheet over the dimmed Locked screen: obviously a dialog. 9 blocks of 5 s, one knock each (the knocks already exist in code).
